name: scm-js plugins
description: The plugins published by the scm-js project.

plugins.name: Aftermath
plugins.description: Opens StarCraft replays over the map they were played on: where buildings went down and when, where units were sent, heat maps of the orders across one game or many, build orders, actions per minute and chat, on a timeline that plays back.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: API Playground
plugins.description: Try the plugin API without writing a plugin. A panel with a code editor where `api` is already in scope, with completion and the reference on hover: write a few lines, run them, and the map changes. Everything a run registers is taken back on Stop. Save snippets, start from worked examples, and export one as a starter plugin.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: eudplib
plugins.description: A library that lets other plugins build EUD maps: it runs eudplib, the trigger compiler behind euddraft, in your browser on your machine (WebAssembly in a Web Worker, via Pyodide). The scmJS desktop app and Docker image include the runtime; anywhere else, the first map you build downloads it once (about 15 MB).
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Hello World
plugins.description: An example plugin to copy from. It adds one Tools menu item that opens a small pane showing the name of the map you have open.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Magenta
plugins.description: A trigger editor for map makers: every trigger reads as a sentence with its parameters as chips, one search box adds any condition or action, and the map is the picker. Carries a catalogue of Remastered EUD conditions and actions that look and behave like the game's own.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Melee Wizard
plugins.description: Builds a ladder-style map's bases in one action each: symmetric start locations for 2, 4 or 8 players, and mineral lines with the geyser laid out on the three-tile ring the game mines fastest from, mirrored to every player. Also mirrors what you select and checks the map's symmetry.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Paint
plugins.description: Drawing tools for the map. Draw lines, boxes, circles, freehand and text out of whatever the palette has picked, whether that is terrain, doodads, units, sprites or fog.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Repair
plugins.description: Open a map and it tells you what is wrong with it: pieces missing or damaged, the tricks protected maps play, terrain the editor cannot edit. Each problem says what the game makes of the map as it stands and what fixing it would change, and it repairs the ones you tick. Restore original puts the file back as it opened.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: scmjs.dev
plugins.description: Your scmjs.dev account in the editor. Keep maps on your account with revisions and notes, and share the open map so others can edit it with you at the same time. Where the server offers them, AI tools can build, lay out and review a map with you.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: scmscx.com
plugins.description: Search scmscx.com, the StarCraft map archive, and open a map from it in the editor. The one item this plugin adds reaches scmscx.com over the network; its mark sits beside it.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Section Explorer
plugins.description: A hex editor that knows the map file. Every section of the scenario, its bytes, and what each byte is: records, fields, flags, and the names behind the numbers. Edit at the byte or at the field.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Stamp Library
plugins.description: Keep the pieces you build once — hand-tuned ramps, bridges, cliff corners, a whole base — as named stamps that stay with the editor across maps. Click one to lay it down anywhere, with a preview under the pointer. Search and tag the library, and share it as a JSON file or a stamp as a line of text.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Terrain from Image
plugins.description: Turn a picture into terrain. Give it an image, say which colour means which terrain, and it lays out the map to match, cliffs and shores included.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Timelapse
plugins.description: Records the map as you build it, one frame per edit, and plays the recording back as an animation. Export it as a GIF or a WebM video. A map you open again keeps adding to the same recording.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: TrigEdit
plugins.description: The Text Trigger Editor: the map's triggers as text in SCMDraft 2's TrigEdit syntax, so text from SCMDraft pastes in and text from here pastes back out. Compile checks it and says which line does not parse. Edits the mission briefing in the same syntax.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Trigger Map
plugins.description: The map's triggers as a graph you can walk. Pick a trigger to see what it waits for and which triggers set that, and what it changes and which triggers read it; pick a switch, death counter, location or Victory to see who writes it and who reads it. Lists what looks wrong: switches nothing sets, counters nothing reads, locations that are not there, triggers that never run.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: TrigScript
plugins.description: TypeScript kept inside the map. Ordinary TypeScript — files, imports, helpers, loops — runs when the script is applied and records one trigger per trigger() call: ordinary triggers that play on every version. Code inside program(() => { … }) runs in the game — variables, loops, functions, sleep — and is built into the map by the eudplib plugin when you save; a map with a program needs StarCraft: Remastered. Checked as you type against the map's own names, with a built-in simulator.
plugins.author: Jeany

plugins.name: Walkability
plugins.description: Reads the ground the way a unit does: islands, unreachable pockets, the areas a map divides into and the chokes between them with their widths, cliff seams with no ramp, and the ground distance between every pair of start locations, drawn over the map.
plugins.author: Jeany
